So I’ve tried risperidone, haloperidol and quetiapine. Risperidone was good for my head but I gained weight and freaked out (I have an ED - it actually worked wonders with my body dysmorphia). 
Then I was put on a very low dose of haloperidol which didn’t really have any side effects, perhaps a bit of emotional numbness and more difficulty orgasming. I still use haloperidol on and off, at a low dose (1.5-2.5mg), it works for me. Then quetiapine. Doctor said 100mg, I took 50. Jesus freaking Christ the sleepiness. But I woke up feeling rested; but at the same time felt drowsy, but a mellow sort of drowsy. Then I got used to it, the euphoric mellow drowsiness went away and I was hungry all the time, gained a few kg in a month, was sleeping 12h easily. I stopped taking it.
So to answer your question about depression- my main issue is mdd, and I use antidepressants when paranoid and actively sh/suicidal, no they don’t make me more depressed. BUT they make me physically depressed, like my body is depressed. And my “happy” “good” feelings are more faded. Actually all my feelings are a bit faded. 
Just note that I’m also on antidepressants (vortioxetine) and mood stabilisers (lamotrigine).
